_comment: Weapon classes and their moves, and the guard tools (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.1-1.3, cooks/combat.md 2.4, cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.1). Read by FWRWeapons (WRWeapons.cpp). An item picks its class with items.json "class" (weapons without one are swords). moves: windup / active / recovery s (the swing clip is timed to them), dmg x the weapon's light (heavy moves: heavy) damage, stance = stance damage to creatures, stamina, poise = poise damage to players, guardStamina = what blocking it costs before the guard boost, impact 1-5 (poise.reactions), next = the light chain's next move, clip = which of the hero's light / heavy clips it plays, ha = hyperarmor from the press to the end of the strike, tier = how its hits feel (fx.hitStop). guard: the class's own guard when no off-hand is carried (boost, physical / element negation, parry startup / active / recovery s). crit: backstab / riposte multipliers of a light hit (a stance-break crit is a riposte). offhands: guard tools; carried = what the hero holds on the left arm today (player_art.json shieldMesh). Shields as items come with the crafting cook: only the carried one is in the game now. All first drafts.
